title: Meta-rdk: Preprocessed EEG data
description: Preprocessed EEG recordings from 20 individuals with a schizophrenia spectrum disorder and 22 healthy control participants performing a visual motion discrimination task with confidence reporting. Motion coherence was adjusted per individual with a staircase procedure to equate performance between groups, allowing study of perceptual decision-making and metacognition in schizophrenia.
methods_description: Participants judged whether 100 moving dots in a central circle moved left or right, responding by moving and clicking a mouse on one of two targets. Motion coherence was individually adapted using a 1up/2down staircase. After each decision, participants rated confidence on a vertical visual analog scale from 0% (sure incorrect) to 100% (sure correct). Diagnoses were based on the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-5.
